MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture discusses phase-change materials used in data storage, such as CDs and DVDs, and in phase-change memory (PCM) technology. PCM stores data by changing electrical conductivity.
